title: Center of it all-Location, Location, Location!
description:
Newly remodeled home in Donelson just minutes from the airport (1.5 miles), Downtown (7 miles), Grand Ole Opry/Land area (5.3 miles), Lakes and parks. Enjoy this centrally located Nashville area home- in the center of it all.  10-15 mins. to most all attractions -  Entire home is yours to enjoy with a large backyard for enjoying the outdoors!

The space
Our 1,100sq ft. home is complete with bedding/linens in 3 bedrooms, 1 bath and open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout.  Spacious backyard with deck for enjoying morning coffee or relaxing evenings.  We are close to downtown ( 7 miles to Broadway/1st Ave.)  Grand Ole Opry, Airport, 2 Lakes, and minutes from all major interstates. Enjoy everything Nashville has to offer and then come back home to relax in your very own home! 
Bedroom 1: Queen bed
Bedroom 2: Queen bed
Bedroom 3: 2 Twin beds
Flat screen TV with Cable, DVD player with some DVD's available, and wireless internet.  Open kitchen with all your cooking needs.  A washer and dryer and laundry detergent is also provided for your use.

Guest access
Entire House is yours to use.  We have a key-less entry for convenient check-in.
